claim: In some countries, buying a dollar from other people costs more than on an exchange, hour after hour.
calculation: From data/findings.json (exchange_vs_p2p evidence): the countries where the gap persists, as the finding defines it (over the last 30 days, at least 7 days of checked hours and a gap of 2 points or more in at least three quarters of them). The figure is the share of the countries that persisted when this test first ran that still persist.
window: the last 30 days of checked hours
min_observations: at least 7 days of checked hours for a country to be judged
invalid_if: the finding's last recheck in data/findings.json is more than 6 hours old, no country persisted when the test first ran, or the minimum observations are not met
thresholds_text: holds: every country that persisted at the start still does. weaker: at least half. no longer true: fewer than half.
proposed_by: Claude, 20 Oct 2026, from ROADMAP.md 'How a finding is tested'; the thresholds are proposals, merged by Seb's 20 Oct rule, and change only through a spec
